dedupe_keys.name: iterative optimization of dis investment in large energy system idiles

description: Iterative Optimization of (Dis-)Investment in Large Energy System (IDILES) is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by University of Duisburg-Essen. IDILES is a model framework based on the detailed dispatch model (JMM) co-optimizing long-term investment and disinvestment decisions. With a Benders’ decomposition approach, components are iteratively adjusted to meet equilibrium conditions. The effects of (dis-)investment decisions on market prices and system costs are considered consistently. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: Benders Decomposition, Iterative Optimization. Time resolution: annual, hour. Spatial resolution: continents, national states, TSO regions, regions, NUTS 3, power stations. Software: GAMS, Matlab. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.
